| MODULE 10:  | Agile Product Management  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module overview: | This module is designed to develop your expertise in Agile Project Management. You will gain a thorough understanding of Agile principles and cultivate an Agile mindset within the project management process, empowering you to manage projects more flexibly and effectively. This module will guide you in designing Agile project plans that align with organizational objectives and adapt to changing project requirements. Additionally, you will learn how to implement Agile methodologies for managing projects iteratively, integrating stakeholder feedback to enhance project outcomes. The module emphasizes the execution of project sprints using Agile techniques, fostering continuous improvement in project delivery and equipping you with the skills necessary to succeed in the fast-paced world of Agile Project Management. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Target Competency | Agile Product Management & Product Development  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module Learning Outcomes  | Apply Agile principles and an Agile mindset to the project management process. Design an Agile project plan that aligns with organizational goals and adapts to changing project requirements. Implement Agile methodologies to manage projects iteratively, incorporating stakeholder feedback effectively. Execute project sprints using Agile techniques, emphasizing continuous improvement in project management processes.  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module 10 Week 4 Content  | www.scrumalliance.org  www.agilealliance.org  www.icagile.com  www.mindtheproduct.com   www.lean.org   www.projectmanagement.com/practices/agile         |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| \[merged\] Week 4 Workshop Outline | Stage6: Sprint Review Stage7: Sprint Retrospective Ensuring Success The Parts of Tens |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| \[merged\] Week 4 Workshop Outline |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4 Assignment  | Assignment Title: Crafting an Agile Product Strategy for Market Success  Introduction:  In this project assignment, you are tasked with applying the principles of Agile Product Development to create a strategic product plan for a new market launch. Your objective is to leverage agile practices, such as defining personas, building a product roadmap, conducting sprints, and managing product feedback to successfully deliver a product aligned with market needs.  You will play the role of an Agile Product Manager at a company launching a new digital product. The focus of your project will be on developing a product vision, building user personas, and iterating on product development through agile methodologies to ensure success in a competitive market.  Task:  Define Product Persona: Identify a target user for your product based on customer interviews or research. Develop a persona with detailed attributes such as demographics, goals, problems, and how they will interact with your product.  Craft a Compelling Product Vision: Write a vision statement for your product that outlines the goals, differentiation, target customers, and unique value proposition. Ensure your vision aligns with the company’s overall strategy and market demands.  Develop a Product Roadmap: Define a product roadmap that outlines key product milestones, epics, and user stories. Prioritize product features based on business value and effort, following Agile methodologies.  Sprint Planning and Execution: Plan a sprint, setting specific goals, choosing user stories, and breaking them into actionable tasks. Demonstrate how your development team will manage sprint reviews and retrospectives to continuously improve.  Agile Feedback Loop: Define a plan for collecting feedback from stakeholders and how to incorporate that feedback into the next development cycle. Ensure that your sprint reviews involve product demonstrations and stakeholder input for adaptive planning.  Evaluation of Success: Create a plan for evaluating the success of your agile product development process. Include metrics such as customer satisfaction, product quality, and team velocity to track the effectiveness of your product development.  Submission Instructions: Your project should reflect a deep understanding of Agile principles and practices. The final report should be 1000-1200 words and submitted as a PDF or Word document. Provide detailed explanations with examples, and include visuals (e.g., product roadmap, sprint backlog).  Learning Outcomes: Understand how to develop product personas and align them with agile product development strategies. Gain practical experience in planning and executing sprints, incorporating feedback, and continuously improving product development. Apply agile methodologies to ensure successful product launches and customer satisfaction.   |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4 Knowledge Check&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9; | 1\. What is the main purpose of a Sprint Review meeting? A) To assess team members' performance. B) To demonstrate the completed product increment and gather stakeholder feedback. C) To create detailed future sprint plans. D) To discuss team collaboration and process improvements.   2\. What should be avoided during a Sprint Review meeting? A) Demonstrating the completed functionality. B) Allowing stakeholders to ask questions. C) Using fancy slides and pageantry. D) Sharing what is coming in the next sprint.   3\. During the Sprint Retrospective, what is the primary goal? A) To gather feedback from external stakeholders. B) To review the budget and timeline for the next sprint. C) To improve the team’s processes, tools, and collaboration for the next sprint. D) To assess the performance of individual team members.   4\. In the Sprint Retrospective, which of the following questions is NOT typically asked? A) What went well during the sprint? B) What should be changed in the team structure? C) What could we improve in the next sprint? D) How can we implement those improvements?    5\. According to the Toyota example, what is the benefit of "stopping the line" when a defect is found? A) It allows the team to optimize the current process without further issues. B) It ensures maximum throughput despite some defects. C) It proactively creates a better system by fixing issues as they occur, leading to long-term gains. D) It helps to avoid employee frustration.         |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| week assignments build up to end-project |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1: Introduction to Digital Transformation and its Drivers |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the concept of digital transformation and its significance in today's business landscape. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring the key drivers of digital transformation, such as technological advancements, changing customer expectations, and competitive pressures. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining case studies and real-world examples of organizations that have successfully embraced digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2: Technology as an Agitator and Enabler |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Analyzing the role of technology as both an agitator and enabler in driving digital transformation initiatives. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and Internet of Things, are disrupting industries and transforming business models. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Assessing the potential risks and challenges associated with technology-driven transformation and strategies for mitigating them. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3: Competitive Positioning and Future-Proof Strategies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the importance of competitive positioning in the digital age and how it differs from traditional business strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring frameworks and methodologies for identifying competitive advantages and developing future-proof strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining successful case studies of organizations that have effectively positioned themselves in the digital marketplace. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4: Building Digital Organizations and Emerging Technologies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Investigating the building blocks of a digital organization, including agile structures, data-driven decision-making, and digital talent management. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Introducing the Digital Feedback Loop as a central framework for continuous improvement and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Reviewing the frameworks such as Gartner's Hype Cycle to identify the most relevant technologies and their potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1 Assignment: Drivers of Digital Transformation Analysis (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Research and analyze three case studies of organizations that have undergone successful digital transformations (or Select one from the pool provided) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Identify and discuss the key drivers that led these organizations to embark on their digital transformation journeys. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a written report highlighting the commonalities and lessons learned from these case studies, and provide recommendations for other organizations seeking to initiate their own digital transformations. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2 Assignment: Technology Disruption and Impact (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Select two emerging technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality) and research their disruptive potential and impact on various industries. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a comparative analysis of the two technologies, evaluating their benefits, challenges, and potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Create a visually engaging presentation summarizing your findings, and deliver a short presentation to the class on the disruptive nature of these technologies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3 Assignment: Future-Proof Strategy Development (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Choose an industry of your interest and conduct a strategic analysis of its competitive landscape in the context of digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| MODULE 11:  | Human-Centred Innovation in Business (Design Thinking)  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module overview: | Focusing on design thinking methodology, you will discuss human-centred design principles, developing a deeper understanding of user needs and cultivating empathy in an effort to create innovative solutions that address real-world problems. Throughout the module, you will be dealing with the design thinking stages, namely; ideation and prototyping phases, translating concepts into tangible and testable solutions. An emphasis on collaborative skills within interdisciplinary teams will be made to empower you to integrate diverse perspectives, fostering creativity and innovation in problem-solving.   |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Target Competency | Design thinking  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module Learning Outcomes  | \- Successfully collaborate within interdisciplinary teams, integrating diverse perspectives and using visual canvases to co-create and communicate innovative solutions that drive creativity and address complex problems. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| week assignments build up to end-project |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1: Introduction to Digital Transformation and its Drivers |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the concept of digital transformation and its significance in today's business landscape. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring the key drivers of digital transformation, such as technological advancements, changing customer expectations, and competitive pressures. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining case studies and real-world examples of organizations that have successfully embraced digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2: Technology as an Agitator and Enabler |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Analyzing the role of technology as both an agitator and enabler in driving digital transformation initiatives. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and Internet of Things, are disrupting industries and transforming business models. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Assessing the potential risks and challenges associated with technology-driven transformation and strategies for mitigating them. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3: Competitive Positioning and Future-Proof Strategies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the importance of competitive positioning in the digital age and how it differs from traditional business strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring frameworks and methodologies for identifying competitive advantages and developing future-proof strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining successful case studies of organizations that have effectively positioned themselves in the digital marketplace. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4: Building Digital Organizations and Emerging Technologies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Investigating the building blocks of a digital organization, including agile structures, data-driven decision-making, and digital talent management. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Introducing the Digital Feedback Loop as a central framework for continuous improvement and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Reviewing the frameworks such as Gartner's Hype Cycle to identify the most relevant technologies and their potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1 Assignment: Drivers of Digital Transformation Analysis (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Research and analyze three case studies of organizations that have undergone successful digital transformations (or Select one from the pool provided) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Identify and discuss the key drivers that led these organizations to embark on their digital transformation journeys. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a written report highlighting the commonalities and lessons learned from these case studies, and provide recommendations for other organizations seeking to initiate their own digital transformations. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2 Assignment: Technology Disruption and Impact (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Select two emerging technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality) and research their disruptive potential and impact on various industries. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a comparative analysis of the two technologies, evaluating their benefits, challenges, and potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Create a visually engaging presentation summarizing your findings, and deliver a short presentation to the class on the disruptive nature of these technologies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3 Assignment: Future-Proof Strategy Development (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Choose an industry of your interest and conduct a strategic analysis of its competitive landscape in the context of digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| MODULE 11:  | Human-Centred Innovation in Business (Design Thinking)  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module overview: | Focusing on design thinking methodology, you will discuss human-centred design principles, developing a deeper understanding of user needs and cultivating empathy in an effort to create innovative solutions that address real-world problems. Throughout the module, you will be dealing with the design thinking stages, namely; ideation and prototyping phases, translating concepts into tangible and testable solutions. An emphasis on collaborative skills within interdisciplinary teams will be made to empower you to integrate diverse perspectives, fostering creativity and innovation in problem-solving.   |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Target Competency | Design thinking  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module Learning Outcomes  | \- Apply human-centred design principles to identify and empathise with user needs, facilitating the creation of innovative solutions that address real-world problems. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| week assignments build up to end-project |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1: Introduction to Digital Transformation and its Drivers |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the concept of digital transformation and its significance in today's business landscape. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring the key drivers of digital transformation, such as technological advancements, changing customer expectations, and competitive pressures. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining case studies and real-world examples of organizations that have successfully embraced digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2: Technology as an Agitator and Enabler |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Analyzing the role of technology as both an agitator and enabler in driving digital transformation initiatives. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and Internet of Things, are disrupting industries and transforming business models. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Assessing the potential risks and challenges associated with technology-driven transformation and strategies for mitigating them. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3: Competitive Positioning and Future-Proof Strategies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the importance of competitive positioning in the digital age and how it differs from traditional business strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring frameworks and methodologies for identifying competitive advantages and developing future-proof strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining successful case studies of organizations that have effectively positioned themselves in the digital marketplace. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4: Building Digital Organizations and Emerging Technologies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Investigating the building blocks of a digital organization, including agile structures, data-driven decision-making, and digital talent management. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Introducing the Digital Feedback Loop as a central framework for continuous improvement and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Reviewing the frameworks such as Gartner's Hype Cycle to identify the most relevant technologies and their potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1 Assignment: Drivers of Digital Transformation Analysis (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Research and analyze three case studies of organizations that have undergone successful digital transformations (or Select one from the pool provided) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Identify and discuss the key drivers that led these organizations to embark on their digital transformation journeys. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a written report highlighting the commonalities and lessons learned from these case studies, and provide recommendations for other organizations seeking to initiate their own digital transformations. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2 Assignment: Technology Disruption and Impact (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Select two emerging technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality) and research their disruptive potential and impact on various industries. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a comparative analysis of the two technologies, evaluating their benefits, challenges, and potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Create a visually engaging presentation summarizing your findings, and deliver a short presentation to the class on the disruptive nature of these technologies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3 Assignment: Future-Proof Strategy Development (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Choose an industry of your interest and conduct a strategic analysis of its competitive landscape in the context of digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| MODULE 11:  | Human-Centred Innovation in Business (Design Thinking)  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module overview: | Focusing on design thinking methodology, you will discuss human-centred design principles, developing a deeper understanding of user needs and cultivating empathy in an effort to create innovative solutions that address real-world problems. Throughout the module, you will be dealing with the design thinking stages, namely; ideation and prototyping phases, translating concepts into tangible and testable solutions. An emphasis on collaborative skills within interdisciplinary teams will be made to empower you to integrate diverse perspectives, fostering creativity and innovation in problem-solving.   |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Target Competency | Design thinking  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module Learning Outcomes  | \- Demonstrate proficiency in the ideation and prototyping phases of the design thinking process, effectively transforming concepts into tangible and testable solutions. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1: Introduction to Digital Transformation and its Drivers |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the concept of digital transformation and its significance in today's business landscape. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring the key drivers of digital transformation, such as technological advancements, changing customer expectations, and competitive pressures. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining case studies and real-world examples of organizations that have successfully embraced digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2: Technology as an Agitator and Enabler |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Analyzing the role of technology as both an agitator and enabler in driving digital transformation initiatives. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and Internet of Things, are disrupting industries and transforming business models. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Assessing the potential risks and challenges associated with technology-driven transformation and strategies for mitigating them. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3: Competitive Positioning and Future-Proof Strategies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the importance of competitive positioning in the digital age and how it differs from traditional business strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring frameworks and methodologies for identifying competitive advantages and developing future-proof strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining successful case studies of organizations that have effectively positioned themselves in the digital marketplace. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4: Building Digital Organizations and Emerging Technologies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Investigating the building blocks of a digital organization, including agile structures, data-driven decision-making, and digital talent management. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Introducing the Digital Feedback Loop as a central framework for continuous improvement and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Reviewing the frameworks such as Gartner's Hype Cycle to identify the most relevant technologies and their potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1 Assignment: Drivers of Digital Transformation Analysis (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Research and analyze three case studies of organizations that have undergone successful digital transformations (or Select one from the pool provided) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Identify and discuss the key drivers that led these organizations to embark on their digital transformation journeys. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a written report highlighting the commonalities and lessons learned from these case studies, and provide recommendations for other organizations seeking to initiate their own digital transformations. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2 Assignment: Technology Disruption and Impact (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Select two emerging technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality) and research their disruptive potential and impact on various industries. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a comparative analysis of the two technologies, evaluating their benefits, challenges, and potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Create a visually engaging presentation summarizing your findings, and deliver a short presentation to the class on the disruptive nature of these technologies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3 Assignment: Future-Proof Strategy Development (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Choose an industry of your interest and conduct a strategic analysis of its competitive landscape in the context of digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| MODULE 11:  | Human-Centred Innovation in Business (Design Thinking)  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module overview: | Focusing on design thinking methodology, you will discuss human-centred design principles, developing a deeper understanding of user needs and cultivating empathy in an effort to create innovative solutions that address real-world problems. Throughout the module, you will be dealing with the design thinking stages, namely; ideation and prototyping phases, translating concepts into tangible and testable solutions. An emphasis on collaborative skills within interdisciplinary teams will be made to empower you to integrate diverse perspectives, fostering creativity and innovation in problem-solving.   |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Target Competency | Design thinking  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module Learning Outcomes  | \- Experiment with design thinking methodologies to bring innovative solutions from conception to execution, ensuring alignment with user needs and business objectives. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| MODULE 12:  | Innovative and Sustainable Business Models |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module overview: | Module 12 centres around the critical competency of innovative and sustainable business development. You will learn how to formulate innovative business models that balance between sustainability and growth in the dynamic tech industry landscape. The module aims to equip you with the skills to adopt the Business Model Canvas effectively, enabling you to design, iterate, and optimise sustainable business models that seamlessly align with the fast-paced tech sector. Moreover, you will discuss comprehensive sustainability strategies that encompass social and environmental commitments, underpinning the foundation of sustainable tech business development. The module also emphasises the evaluation and adaptation of innovative sustainability initiatives, fostering lasting success and adaptability within tech-related ventures, preparing you to thrive in a business landscape that values both innovation and sustainability.  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Target Competency | Innovative and sustainable business development  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module Learning Outcomes  | \-Apply the Business Model Canvas to design, iterate, and optimise sustainable business models, aligning them with the fast-paced tech sector. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| week assignments build up to end-project |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1: Introduction to Digital Transformation and its Drivers |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the concept of digital transformation and its significance in today's business landscape. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring the key drivers of digital transformation, such as technological advancements, changing customer expectations, and competitive pressures. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining case studies and real-world examples of organizations that have successfully embraced digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2: Technology as an Agitator and Enabler |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Analyzing the role of technology as both an agitator and enabler in driving digital transformation initiatives. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and Internet of Things, are disrupting industries and transforming business models. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Assessing the potential risks and challenges associated with technology-driven transformation and strategies for mitigating them. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3: Competitive Positioning and Future-Proof Strategies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the importance of competitive positioning in the digital age and how it differs from traditional business strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring frameworks and methodologies for identifying competitive advantages and developing future-proof strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining successful case studies of organizations that have effectively positioned themselves in the digital marketplace. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4: Building Digital Organizations and Emerging Technologies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Investigating the building blocks of a digital organization, including agile structures, data-driven decision-making, and digital talent management. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Introducing the Digital Feedback Loop as a central framework for continuous improvement and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Reviewing the frameworks such as Gartner's Hype Cycle to identify the most relevant technologies and their potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1 Assignment: Drivers of Digital Transformation Analysis (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Research and analyze three case studies of organizations that have undergone successful digital transformations (or Select one from the pool provided) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Identify and discuss the key drivers that led these organizations to embark on their digital transformation journeys. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a written report highlighting the commonalities and lessons learned from these case studies, and provide recommendations for other organizations seeking to initiate their own digital transformations. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2 Assignment: Technology Disruption and Impact (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Select two emerging technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality) and research their disruptive potential and impact on various industries. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a comparative analysis of the two technologies, evaluating their benefits, challenges, and potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Create a visually engaging presentation summarizing your findings, and deliver a short presentation to the class on the disruptive nature of these technologies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3 Assignment: Future-Proof Strategy Development (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Choose an industry of your interest and conduct a strategic analysis of its competitive landscape in the context of digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| MODULE 12:  | Innovative and Sustainable Business Models |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module overview: | Module 12 centres around the critical competency of innovative and sustainable business development. You will learn how to formulate innovative business models that balance between sustainability and growth in the dynamic tech industry landscape. The module aims to equip you with the skills to adopt the Business Model Canvas effectively, enabling you to design, iterate, and optimise sustainable business models that seamlessly align with the fast-paced tech sector. Moreover, you will discuss comprehensive sustainability strategies that encompass social and environmental commitments, underpinning the foundation of sustainable tech business development. The module also emphasises the evaluation and adaptation of innovative sustainability initiatives, fostering lasting success and adaptability within tech-related ventures, preparing you to thrive in a business landscape that values both innovation and sustainability.  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Target Competency | Innovative and sustainable business development  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module Learning Outcomes  | \- Devise and implement comprehensive sustainability strategies that meet both social and environmental commitments, ensuring sustainable tech business development. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| week assignments build up to end-project |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1: Introduction to Digital Transformation and its Drivers |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the concept of digital transformation and its significance in today's business landscape. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring the key drivers of digital transformation, such as technological advancements, changing customer expectations, and competitive pressures. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining case studies and real-world examples of organizations that have successfully embraced digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2: Technology as an Agitator and Enabler |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Analyzing the role of technology as both an agitator and enabler in driving digital transformation initiatives. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and Internet of Things, are disrupting industries and transforming business models. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Assessing the potential risks and challenges associated with technology-driven transformation and strategies for mitigating them. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3: Competitive Positioning and Future-Proof Strategies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the importance of competitive positioning in the digital age and how it differs from traditional business strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring frameworks and methodologies for identifying competitive advantages and developing future-proof strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining successful case studies of organizations that have effectively positioned themselves in the digital marketplace. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4: Building Digital Organizations and Emerging Technologies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Investigating the building blocks of a digital organization, including agile structures, data-driven decision-making, and digital talent management. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Introducing the Digital Feedback Loop as a central framework for continuous improvement and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Reviewing the frameworks such as Gartner's Hype Cycle to identify the most relevant technologies and their potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1 Assignment: Drivers of Digital Transformation Analysis (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Research and analyze three case studies of organizations that have undergone successful digital transformations (or Select one from the pool provided) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Identify and discuss the key drivers that led these organizations to embark on their digital transformation journeys. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a written report highlighting the commonalities and lessons learned from these case studies, and provide recommendations for other organizations seeking to initiate their own digital transformations. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2 Assignment: Technology Disruption and Impact (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Select two emerging technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality) and research their disruptive potential and impact on various industries. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a comparative analysis of the two technologies, evaluating their benefits, challenges, and potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Create a visually engaging presentation summarizing your findings, and deliver a short presentation to the class on the disruptive nature of these technologies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3 Assignment: Future-Proof Strategy Development (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Choose an industry of your interest and conduct a strategic analysis of its competitive landscape in the context of digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| MODULE 12:  | Innovative and Sustainable Business Models |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module overview: | Module 12 centres around the critical competency of innovative and sustainable business development. You will learn how to formulate innovative business models that balance between sustainability and growth in the dynamic tech industry landscape. The module aims to equip you with the skills to adopt the Business Model Canvas effectively, enabling you to design, iterate, and optimise sustainable business models that seamlessly align with the fast-paced tech sector. Moreover, you will discuss comprehensive sustainability strategies that encompass social and environmental commitments, underpinning the foundation of sustainable tech business development. The module also emphasises the evaluation and adaptation of innovative sustainability initiatives, fostering lasting success and adaptability within tech-related ventures, preparing you to thrive in a business landscape that values both innovation and sustainability.  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Target Competency | Innovative and sustainable business development  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module Learning Outcomes  | \-Evaluate and adapt innovative sustainability initiatives, fostering lasting success and adaptability in tech-related ventures. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| Week 1: Introduction to Digital Transformation and its Drivers |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the concept of digital transformation and its significance in today's business landscape. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring the key drivers of digital transformation, such as technological advancements, changing customer expectations, and competitive pressures. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining case studies and real-world examples of organizations that have successfully embraced digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2: Technology as an Agitator and Enabler |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Analyzing the role of technology as both an agitator and enabler in driving digital transformation initiatives. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and Internet of Things, are disrupting industries and transforming business models. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Assessing the potential risks and challenges associated with technology-driven transformation and strategies for mitigating them. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3: Competitive Positioning and Future-Proof Strategies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the importance of competitive positioning in the digital age and how it differs from traditional business strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring frameworks and methodologies for identifying competitive advantages and developing future-proof strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining successful case studies of organizations that have effectively positioned themselves in the digital marketplace. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4: Building Digital Organizations and Emerging Technologies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Investigating the building blocks of a digital organization, including agile structures, data-driven decision-making, and digital talent management. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Introducing the Digital Feedback Loop as a central framework for continuous improvement and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Reviewing the frameworks such as Gartner's Hype Cycle to identify the most relevant technologies and their potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1 Assignment: Drivers of Digital Transformation Analysis (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Research and analyze three case studies of organizations that have undergone successful digital transformations (or Select one from the pool provided) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Identify and discuss the key drivers that led these organizations to embark on their digital transformation journeys. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a written report highlighting the commonalities and lessons learned from these case studies, and provide recommendations for other organizations seeking to initiate their own digital transformations. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2 Assignment: Technology Disruption and Impact (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Select two emerging technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality) and research their disruptive potential and impact on various industries. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a comparative analysis of the two technologies, evaluating their benefits, challenges, and potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Create a visually engaging presentation summarizing your findings, and deliver a short presentation to the class on the disruptive nature of these technologies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3 Assignment: Future-Proof Strategy Development (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Choose an industry of your interest and conduct a strategic analysis of its competitive landscape in the context of digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| MODULE 13:  | Growth Hacking |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module overview: | Throughout this module, you will gain an understanding of growth hacking strategies, helping you explore new channels and platforms, thereby enhancing customer acquisition and optimising conversion rates to fuel business growth and innovation. The module emphasises data as a key component, enabling you to make informed decisions in the growth hacking process and use insights to continually improve business practices while adapting to ever-changing market conditions. You will also develop customer acquisition plans, refining your ability to efficiently target and reach potential clients, resulting in a substantial expansion of your customer base. Moreover, the module delves into the evaluation of automation techniques in growth hacking efforts, streamlining processes and ensuring the scalability of innovative practices, all contributing to sustainable business development. This module prepares you to excel in the dynamic field of growth hacking, where rapid, data-driven experimentation drives business expansion and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Target Competency | Growth hacking  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module Learning Outcomes  | \- Display understanding in growth hacking strategies to explore new channels and platforms, enhancing customer acquisition, and optimising conversion rates to stimulate business growth and innovation. \-Analyse data to make informed decisions in the growth hacking process, utilising insights to improve business practices and adapt to changing market conditions effectively. \-Develop customer acquisition plans to efficiently target and reach potential clients, resulting in increased customer base expansion \-Evaluate automation techniques in growth hacking efforts, streamlining processes and ensuring the scalability of innovative practices for sustainable business development.  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| Week 1 Assignment  | Write a Press Release for a (fictive) product launch based on the Amazon Working Backwards Method shown in the slides provided during the first week of Module 13 (max 2 pages). Please apply this Press Release to your own company or organization to make it more pragmatic. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1 Knowledge Check | 1\. What is the primary focus of growth hacking as discussed by Ryan Holiday? A) Enhancing the visual appeal of a product B) Building a strong marketing and sales team  C) Increasing brand awareness through traditional advertising D) Rapid and scalable growth using creative, data-driven strategies  2\. According to Holiday, which of the following is NOT typically part of a growth hacker's toolkit? A) Data analysis B) Cold calling C) Viral marketing D) Product engineering 3\. In the early stages, what does Holiday suggest growth hackers should prioritize? A) Perfecting the product’s appearance B) Achieving product-market fit C) Securing a large advertising budget D) Working mainly on product development 4\. Which term does Holiday use to describe a product that practically markets itself because of its design? A) Purple Cow B) Product-market fit C) Self-promoting product D) Social proof 5\. According to Holiday, why is it essential to measure and analyze user behavior? A) To understand what drives user engagement and retention B) To establish a strong brand identity C) To develop team cohesion D) To create more creative advertisements based on data analysis |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| Week 1: Introduction to Digital Transformation and its Drivers |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the concept of digital transformation and its significance in today's business landscape. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring the key drivers of digital transformation, such as technological advancements, changing customer expectations, and competitive pressures. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining case studies and real-world examples of organizations that have successfully embraced digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2: Technology as an Agitator and Enabler |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Analyzing the role of technology as both an agitator and enabler in driving digital transformation initiatives. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and Internet of Things, are disrupting industries and transforming business models. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Assessing the potential risks and challenges associated with technology-driven transformation and strategies for mitigating them. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3: Competitive Positioning and Future-Proof Strategies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the importance of competitive positioning in the digital age and how it differs from traditional business strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring frameworks and methodologies for identifying competitive advantages and developing future-proof strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining successful case studies of organizations that have effectively positioned themselves in the digital marketplace. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4: Building Digital Organizations and Emerging Technologies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Investigating the building blocks of a digital organization, including agile structures, data-driven decision-making, and digital talent management. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Introducing the Digital Feedback Loop as a central framework for continuous improvement and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Reviewing the frameworks such as Gartner's Hype Cycle to identify the most relevant technologies and their potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1 Assignment: Drivers of Digital Transformation Analysis (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Research and analyze three case studies of organizations that have undergone successful digital transformations (or Select one from the pool provided) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Identify and discuss the key drivers that led these organizations to embark on their digital transformation journeys. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a written report highlighting the commonalities and lessons learned from these case studies, and provide recommendations for other organizations seeking to initiate their own digital transformations. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2 Assignment: Technology Disruption and Impact (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Select two emerging technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality) and research their disruptive potential and impact on various industries. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a comparative analysis of the two technologies, evaluating their benefits, challenges, and potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Create a visually engaging presentation summarizing your findings, and deliver a short presentation to the class on the disruptive nature of these technologies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3 Assignment: Future-Proof Strategy Development (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Choose an industry of your interest and conduct a strategic analysis of its competitive landscape in the context of digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| MODULE 13:  | Growth Hacking |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module overview: | Throughout this module, you will gain an understanding of growth hacking strategies, helping you explore new channels and platforms, thereby enhancing customer acquisition and optimising conversion rates to fuel business growth and innovation. The module emphasises data as a key component, enabling you to make informed decisions in the growth hacking process and use insights to continually improve business practices while adapting to ever-changing market conditions. You will also develop customer acquisition plans, refining your ability to efficiently target and reach potential clients, resulting in a substantial expansion of your customer base. Moreover, the module delves into the evaluation of automation techniques in growth hacking efforts, streamlining processes and ensuring the scalability of innovative practices, all contributing to sustainable business development. This module prepares you to excel in the dynamic field of growth hacking, where rapid, data-driven experimentation drives business expansion and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Target Competency | Growth hacking  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module Learning Outcomes  | \- Display understanding in growth hacking strategies to explore new channels and platforms, enhancing customer acquisition, and optimising conversion rates to stimulate business growth and innovation. \-Analyse data to make informed decisions in the growth hacking process, utilising insights to improve business practices and adapt to changing market conditions effectively. \-Develop customer acquisition plans to efficiently target and reach potential clients, resulting in increased customer base expansion \-Evaluate automation techniques in growth hacking efforts, streamlining processes and ensuring the scalability of innovative practices for sustainable business development.  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| Week 2 Assignment  | Provide an essay (max 600 words) answering the following questions: Who are my ideal early adopters? How can I make my platform particularly enticing to them right now?  Why is this service indispensable? Or how do I make it indispensable?  Once they come on board, does the service provide/encourage/facilitate them inviting or bringing more users with them?  How willing and prepared am I to improve based on the feedback and behavior of these users?  What kind of crazy/cool thing can I do to get attention–something that, ideally, no one has done before? |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2 Knowledge Check | 1\. According to Andrew Chen’s framework, what is a key factor for evaluating the quality of a startup's user growth? A) Retention rates B) The startup’s founders network C) The founder’s educational background D) The company's public relations strategy 2\. In Chen's evaluation framework, which metric is particularly important to determine if growth is sustainable? A) Number of employees B) Gross revenue C) User engagement D) Revenue 3\. Which of the following growth indicators is seen as a sign of poor growth quality in Chen's framework? A) Low user engagement B) High churn rate C) Limited organic referrals D) Average Ad spent per user 4\. In Andrew Chen's framework, what is considered a signal of healthy growth within a startup? A) Organic user acquisition B) High advertising expenditure C) A significant number of short-term users D) Dependence on discounts 5\. According to Chen, why is "user retention" critical in evaluating growth quality? A) It boosts the startup’s valuation B) It shows that users find lasting value in the product C) It increases the startup’s brand visibility D) It enhances the user experience by improved product development and design |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1: Introduction to Digital Transformation and its Drivers |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the concept of digital transformation and its significance in today's business landscape. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring the key drivers of digital transformation, such as technological advancements, changing customer expectations, and competitive pressures. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining case studies and real-world examples of organizations that have successfully embraced digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2: Technology as an Agitator and Enabler |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Analyzing the role of technology as both an agitator and enabler in driving digital transformation initiatives. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and Internet of Things, are disrupting industries and transforming business models. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Assessing the potential risks and challenges associated with technology-driven transformation and strategies for mitigating them. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3: Competitive Positioning and Future-Proof Strategies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the importance of competitive positioning in the digital age and how it differs from traditional business strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring frameworks and methodologies for identifying competitive advantages and developing future-proof strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining successful case studies of organizations that have effectively positioned themselves in the digital marketplace. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4: Building Digital Organizations and Emerging Technologies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Investigating the building blocks of a digital organization, including agile structures, data-driven decision-making, and digital talent management. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Introducing the Digital Feedback Loop as a central framework for continuous improvement and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Reviewing the frameworks such as Gartner's Hype Cycle to identify the most relevant technologies and their potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1 Assignment: Drivers of Digital Transformation Analysis (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Research and analyze three case studies of organizations that have undergone successful digital transformations (or Select one from the pool provided) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Identify and discuss the key drivers that led these organizations to embark on their digital transformation journeys. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a written report highlighting the commonalities and lessons learned from these case studies, and provide recommendations for other organizations seeking to initiate their own digital transformations. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2 Assignment: Technology Disruption and Impact (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Select two emerging technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality) and research their disruptive potential and impact on various industries. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a comparative analysis of the two technologies, evaluating their benefits, challenges, and potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Create a visually engaging presentation summarizing your findings, and deliver a short presentation to the class on the disruptive nature of these technologies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3 Assignment: Future-Proof Strategy Development (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Choose an industry of your interest and conduct a strategic analysis of its competitive landscape in the context of digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| MODULE 13:  | Growth Hacking |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module overview: | Throughout this module, you will gain an understanding of growth hacking strategies, helping you explore new channels and platforms, thereby enhancing customer acquisition and optimising conversion rates to fuel business growth and innovation. The module emphasises data as a key component, enabling you to make informed decisions in the growth hacking process and use insights to continually improve business practices while adapting to ever-changing market conditions. You will also develop customer acquisition plans, refining your ability to efficiently target and reach potential clients, resulting in a substantial expansion of your customer base. Moreover, the module delves into the evaluation of automation techniques in growth hacking efforts, streamlining processes and ensuring the scalability of innovative practices, all contributing to sustainable business development. This module prepares you to excel in the dynamic field of growth hacking, where rapid, data-driven experimentation drives business expansion and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Target Competency | Growth hacking  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module Learning Outcomes  | \- Display understanding in growth hacking strategies to explore new channels and platforms, enhancing customer acquisition, and optimising conversion rates to stimulate business growth and innovation. \-Analyse data to make informed decisions in the growth hacking process, utilising insights to improve business practices and adapt to changing market conditions effectively. \-Develop customer acquisition plans to efficiently target and reach potential clients, resulting in increased customer base expansion \-Evaluate automation techniques in growth hacking efforts, streamlining processes and ensuring the scalability of innovative practices for sustainable business development.  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| Week 1: Introduction to Digital Transformation and its Drivers |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the concept of digital transformation and its significance in today's business landscape. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring the key drivers of digital transformation, such as technological advancements, changing customer expectations, and competitive pressures. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining case studies and real-world examples of organizations that have successfully embraced digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2: Technology as an Agitator and Enabler |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Analyzing the role of technology as both an agitator and enabler in driving digital transformation initiatives. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and Internet of Things, are disrupting industries and transforming business models. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Assessing the potential risks and challenges associated with technology-driven transformation and strategies for mitigating them. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3: Competitive Positioning and Future-Proof Strategies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the importance of competitive positioning in the digital age and how it differs from traditional business strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring frameworks and methodologies for identifying competitive advantages and developing future-proof strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining successful case studies of organizations that have effectively positioned themselves in the digital marketplace. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4: Building Digital Organizations and Emerging Technologies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Investigating the building blocks of a digital organization, including agile structures, data-driven decision-making, and digital talent management. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Introducing the Digital Feedback Loop as a central framework for continuous improvement and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Reviewing the frameworks such as Gartner's Hype Cycle to identify the most relevant technologies and their potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1 Assignment: Drivers of Digital Transformation Analysis (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Research and analyze three case studies of organizations that have undergone successful digital transformations (or Select one from the pool provided) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Identify and discuss the key drivers that led these organizations to embark on their digital transformation journeys. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a written report highlighting the commonalities and lessons learned from these case studies, and provide recommendations for other organizations seeking to initiate their own digital transformations. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2 Assignment: Technology Disruption and Impact (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Select two emerging technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality) and research their disruptive potential and impact on various industries. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a comparative analysis of the two technologies, evaluating their benefits, challenges, and potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Create a visually engaging presentation summarizing your findings, and deliver a short presentation to the class on the disruptive nature of these technologies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3 Assignment: Future-Proof Strategy Development (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Choose an industry of your interest and conduct a strategic analysis of its competitive landscape in the context of digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| MODULE 13:  | Growth Hacking |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module overview: | Throughout this module, you will gain an understanding of growth hacking strategies, helping you explore new channels and platforms, thereby enhancing customer acquisition and optimising conversion rates to fuel business growth and innovation. The module emphasises data as a key component, enabling you to make informed decisions in the growth hacking process and use insights to continually improve business practices while adapting to ever-changing market conditions. You will also develop customer acquisition plans, refining your ability to efficiently target and reach potential clients, resulting in a substantial expansion of your customer base. Moreover, the module delves into the evaluation of automation techniques in growth hacking efforts, streamlining processes and ensuring the scalability of innovative practices, all contributing to sustainable business development. This module prepares you to excel in the dynamic field of growth hacking, where rapid, data-driven experimentation drives business expansion and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Target Competency | Growth hacking  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Module Learning Outcomes  | \- Display understanding in growth hacking strategies to explore new channels and platforms, enhancing customer acquisition, and optimising conversion rates to stimulate business growth and innovation. \-Analyse data to make informed decisions in the growth hacking process, utilising insights to improve business practices and adapt to changing market conditions effectively. \-Develop customer acquisition plans to efficiently target and reach potential clients, resulting in increased customer base expansion \-Evaluate automation techniques in growth hacking efforts, streamlining processes and ensuring the scalability of innovative practices for sustainable business development.  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| Week 4 Knowledge Check | What is one of the common myths about growth hacking? A. Growth hacking is primarily for B2C companies. B. Growth hacking requires high financial resources. C. Growth hacking is only suitable for tech and digital companies.  D. Growth hacking is a long-term process only. According to the article, what has growth hacking evolved to include beyond traditional marketing tactics? A. Exclusive focus on acquisition. B. Integration with traditional marketing activities.  C. Automation with data-driven decisions. D. A product-centric approach. Which approach is emphasized as key in growth hacking to support rapid decision-making? A. Linear, hierarchical decision-making. B. Iterative experimentation and flexibility.  C. Quantitative data analysis. D. Static market forecasting. What is a critical role of data in growth hacking strategies? A. To create assumptions without validation. B. To focus on customer acquisition. C. To enable systematic experimentation and personalization.  D. To focus on creative aspects of marketing. The article suggests that growth hacking is fundamentally: A. A one-size-fits-all approach. B. Primarily about optimizing digital content. C. A dynamic methodology adaptable to various business models.  D. A process used in the high-tech industries. What is highlighted as a necessary organizational change for effective growth hacking? A. Establishing top-down processes. B. Implementing a lean, data-driven structure.  C. Prioritizing intuition-based marketing over data. D. Developing cross-functional team interactions. Which of the following best defines the mindset required for growth hacking according to the article? A. Focusing on marketing team activities. B. Applying clear processes for consistent outcomes. C. Embracing continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.  D. Reduce risks. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1: Introduction to Digital Transformation and its Drivers |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the concept of digital transformation and its significance in today's business landscape. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring the key drivers of digital transformation, such as technological advancements, changing customer expectations, and competitive pressures. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining case studies and real-world examples of organizations that have successfully embraced digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2: Technology as an Agitator and Enabler |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Analyzing the role of technology as both an agitator and enabler in driving digital transformation initiatives. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and Internet of Things, are disrupting industries and transforming business models. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Assessing the potential risks and challenges associated with technology-driven transformation and strategies for mitigating them. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3: Competitive Positioning and Future-Proof Strategies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Understanding the importance of competitive positioning in the digital age and how it differs from traditional business strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Exploring frameworks and methodologies for identifying competitive advantages and developing future-proof strategies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Examining successful case studies of organizations that have effectively positioned themselves in the digital marketplace. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 4: Building Digital Organizations and Emerging Technologies |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Investigating the building blocks of a digital organization, including agile structures, data-driven decision-making, and digital talent management. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Introducing the Digital Feedback Loop as a central framework for continuous improvement and innovation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Reviewing the frameworks such as Gartner's Hype Cycle to identify the most relevant technologies and their potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 1 Assignment: Drivers of Digital Transformation Analysis (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Research and analyze three case studies of organizations that have undergone successful digital transformations (or Select one from the pool provided) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Identify and discuss the key drivers that led these organizations to embark on their digital transformation journeys. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a written report highlighting the commonalities and lessons learned from these case studies, and provide recommendations for other organizations seeking to initiate their own digital transformations. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 2 Assignment: Technology Disruption and Impact (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Select two emerging technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality) and research their disruptive potential and impact on various industries. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Prepare a comparative analysis of the two technologies, evaluating their benefits, challenges, and potential applications in business. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Create a visually engaging presentation summarizing your findings, and deliver a short presentation to the class on the disruptive nature of these technologies. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Week 3 Assignment: Future-Proof Strategy Development (Estimated 8 hours) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Choose an industry of your interest and conduct a strategic analysis of its competitive landscape in the context of digital transformation. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
